other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan
Must be studying Urdu as an optional subject at the graduation or post‑graduation level
Must be regularly enrolled in a recognized college or university
Graduation‑level applicants need at least 50 % marks in the previous qualifying examination
Post‑graduation‑level applicants need at least a second division in the previous examination
For renewal, the student must have been sanctioned a scholarship in the previous year and must have secured at least 50 % marks and passed in second division in the last examination
benefits_summary: Monthly scholarship of ₹100 for undergraduate students and ₹150 for postgraduate students studying Urdu.
